title: WorkflowDispatchResult
description: Normalized result of one headless Atomic workflow dispatch, derived from the terminal workflow.run.end NDJSON event (empirical finding A14). Produced by skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/workflow_dispatch.py.

run_id.description: Full 36-character UUID of the Atomic workflow run.

status.description: Terminal status from workflow.run.end. 'blocked' is retryable after reauth/provider recovery; 'failed' is terminal for the attempt.

workflow_name.description: Name of the dispatched workflow definition (builtin or .atomic/workflows/*.ts).

result.description: The workflow's typed output object as declared by its outputs schema; null when the run did not complete.

error_message.description: Error text extracted from the stream (stopReason:'error' errorMessage, finding A5) or the failed run.end payload; null on success. Secret-redacted before persistence.

duration_ms.description: durationMs from workflow.run.end, or wall-clock fallback when absent.

exit_code.description: Subprocess exit code of the atomic invocation (0 expected on completed, finding A14).

reauth_hint.description: Present iff status='blocked' and the block is auth-shaped: 'set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment or run interactive /login' (finding A6, decision D3).

worktree_path.description: Managed worktree the run executed in (finding A19: worktree isolation is mandatory).

provider.description: Explicitly pinned provider (always set per finding A10; 'openrouter' in this change).

model.description: Explicitly pinned model slug (always set per finding A10).
